name: one-india-platform
description: Read approved 1 India Family Mart retail reports: sales and targets, footfall, stock ageing with cost values, Inventory Intelligence, dispatch progress with order values, purchase-cohort sell-through, catalogue photos, monthly sales vs last year, store P&L with margins, loyalty summary, monthly booked rent and salary (named salary approval required).

interface.longDescription: Read your approved 1 India stores' sales, targets, footfall, category stock and sell-through. Separately approved reports add stock ageing with stock cost values, warehouse dispatch progress with order-rate/MRP values, company purchase-cohort sell-through, Inventory Intelligence and slow stock, catalogue styles and photos, monthly sales versus last year, category sales, top styles, Finance MIS store P&L with margins, the company loyalty summary, Finance booked rent and monthly salary. Salary needs the platform's named salary-access approval, rechecked on every call, and can include individual employee pay for those approved viewers; bank, tax and contact details are never returned. Share a short unanswered question with the connector owner only after confirming the exact summary. Your own login, selected reports and store scope are required; business records stay read-only.
capabilities: Read approved retail sales, targets and stock reports
Read stock cost values and dispatch order values
Read monthly sales vs last year, store P&L and loyalty summary
Read monthly booked rent and salary (named approval)
defaultPrompt: Check my 1 India AI access and show the reports and stores I can use.
Compare sales against targets and category sell-through for one approved store last week.
Show me a redacted summary of any unanswered report question and ask before saving it.
